_comment: En-route VFR chatter on a Flight Information Service (FIS / 'Information'). No home airport — enroute is true, sizes ignored. atc_callsign defaults to 'Information' unless the backend supplies a regional FIS name.

lines.speaker: atc
lines.text: {callsign}, {atc_callsign}, basic service, squawk 7000, pass your message.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: {callsign}, Cessna 172, 4500 feet, en route to the east, request traffic information.

lines.speaker: atc
lines.text: {callsign}, traffic, two o'clock, 4 miles, crossing left to right, type unknown.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: {atc_callsign}, {callsign}, leaving your area to the south, request frequency change.

lines.speaker: atc
lines.text: {callsign}, frequency change approved, squawk 7000, good day.
